Cơm đậu hũ sốt cà

Tofu in tomato sauce with rice and dried-shrimp greens soup

APPROX. PREP TIME
18 min
MAKES
1 serving

Rice and dried-shrimp soup are cooked ahead; tofu is already lightly fried.

Equipment: Frying pan

THE METHOD

In the kitchen.

Tap a step number to keep your place.

✓
Prepare the tofu

Cut the pre-fried tofu into bite-sized pieces. Starting with raw tofu needs extra frying time.

02
Cook the tomatoes

Fry the shallot, then add chopped tomatoes and cook into a sauce.

03
Simmer in sauce

Add tofu, fish sauce and pepper; simmer gently for 5 minutes.

04
Serve with rice and soup

Finish with spring onion and serve with rice and the prepared soup.
